description: Fix remaining errData.error call sites and add comprehensive tests for parse-responsibilities.ts
acceptance_criteria: No remaining errData.error patterns in the codebase without extractErrorMessage
verification: Run `grep -rn 'errData.error' src/` and confirm no unprotected usages
Run `npx vitest run` and confirm all tests pass
Run `npm run lint && npm run build` and confirm success
findings: Fixed 9 additional errData.error call sites across companies, company/[slug], DraftsTab, skills (3 sites), experience, jobs, and phrases pages. Added 46 tests for parse-responsibilities.ts covering action verb extraction, bullet stripping, prefix removal, section detection, keyword extraction, deduplication, and edge cases. Discovered that section detection requires headers > 20 chars (due to line length filtering) and is sensitive to keyword collisions (a line containing 'requirements' as a substring triggers section change).
